events.title: Farm House Family Day: Autumnal Wonders
events.description:
Celebrate autumn with us with fall crafts and activities!

The leaves are changing colors, the days are getting shorter, and we’re putting the farm to sleep. Come celebrate autumn with us! Enjoy fall crafts, house tours, and outdoor activities. 

We will be joined by Open House New York and offering exclusive tours that explore the architectural history that made cooking, growing, and storing food possible in this 17th century Dutch Farmhouse. 

Prepare for your visit:

  • Farmhouse Family Day is from 11AM-3PM. This is an all ages event, ideal for kids ages 4-12.
  • Tours of the Wyckoff House will be available starting at 11:30 AM.
  • Dress appropriately for the weather as Family Day takes place indoors and outdoors – make sure to wear closed toed shoes if you plan on participating in any farm activities.
